lessons_control.note: pre_lessons is each hunter's own sum before it read researcher_us/LESSONS.md. edge_resolve.py ranks it against the same realised move as the key, which is the only thing that can tell the guidance file apart from a habit.

language_control.note: pre_local is each hunter's own sum after the ENGLISH pass and before the local pass. eu_resolve.py ranks it against the same realised move as the key, per market, and does not pool the UK (where the second pass varies source locality) with Germany and France (where it varies language).

note: Ranked on impact_sum: the hunters' signed per-finding sizes, added up, in points of spot. No call and no threshold -- cut wherever you like afterwards, which is what keeps the ranking question answerable at every k. `conviction` (abs of the key) is where the direction skill lives: over all events the sign is a coin flip, above the median conviction it is 74%. conviction_floor is a floor on emphasis in the note, never a filter on this file. Everything under `diagnostics` was measured as neutral or subtractive and decides nothing -- see researcher_us/EDGE_ANALYSIS.md.

hunter_view.baseline_tension: Mixed, and the disagreement is the reason the emitted number is 1.7 points below the sum of the findings: the evidence agrees with this name's own reaction function (both comparable falls of the last three years bounced, +1.77% and +1.57%, median +1.67%, 2 of 2) and with the modest 2.75x volume spike, which sits at the benign end of the base rate where under-2x fallers average +1.46%, but it cuts against the 12.1% ATR14 - the best free ranker in phase 0 says high-ATR fallers keep falling - against the -0.30% cross-sectional prior for this drop and turnover band, against a close that printed one tick off the session low, and against an intraday shape that rallied 4.6% before it broke, which is not the from-the-open weakness a clean index unwind produces.

findings.finding: The buyer that made the price is a dated index trade that has already cleared, and the 2026-09-21 session completed a full round trip back through the pre-index level - SCTX joined the Russell 2000/3000 at the 09-21 open, trackers bought 2,236,400 shares ($73.8m, 13x the $5.7m 20-day median) at the 2026-09-18 close, and the $28.05 drop-day close is now 4.7% BELOW the 2026-09-14 close of $29.42 and 3.6% below the 2026-09-16 close of $29.10.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This name has no prior index event. Its own two comparable falls both bounced the next close: 2026-08-13 -11.47% then +1.77%, 2026-08-25 -16.21% then +1.57%, median +1.67%, 2 of 2 up (sealed baseline history block, 3-year lookback on observed daily closes).

findings.finding: Nothing was disclosed behind the fall and the balance sheet offers no second leg: no SEC filing of any kind since the 2026-09-02 10-Q and Item 2.02 8-K, no press release since 2026-09-02, no analyst action found around 09-21, zero 'at-the-market' hits ever in this issuer's full-text filing history, zero 'minimum bid price' and zero 'non-reliance' hits, and $43.0m of cash at 30 June plus ~$140.6m of net IPO proceeds guided to fund operations into the first half of 2029.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The last time this issuer put a document in front of the market - the Q2 release and 10-Q of 2026-09-02 - the stock closed +3.7% that day at $30.90 on 278,700 shares and gave it back over the following two sessions to $28.67; its document-driven moves have been an order of magnitude smaller than 15%.

findings.finding: The four-business-day 8-K clock on any 2026-09-21 reportable event is still running to 2026-09-25, and the drop-day's intraday shape argues against attributing all of the fall to flow: the stock opened at $32.88, rallied 4.6% to $34.49, and only then fell 21% to a $27.32 low, which is not the from-the-open weakness an index unwind produces.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This issuer has filed two 8-Ks since listing - 2026-07-27 (Items 5.03, 9.01) and 2026-09-02 (Items 2.02, 9.01) - and neither was a negative surprise; there is no instance of an unscheduled 8-K from this company to score against.

hunter_view.baseline_tension: It agrees, which is the honest problem with it - 22.5x volume points to -2.44% next session, a 15.4% ATR is the high end of the best free ranker, and a +50.5% twenty-day run-up makes the free control -run_up_20d_pct already strongly negative on this name, so my research is pointing the same way as three things that cost nothing to compute; the one thing that cuts against all of it is this stock's own history, where four of eight comparable falls rose the next close, and that is the point I took off the finding sum.

flags: 5 finding(s) worth +0.00 dated after the exit window, kept out of the key

findings.finding: The primary document is weaker than the headline it was sold under: the week-12 primary endpoint separates CUE-221 from the omalizumab arm by 13 points untested, the 'fundamental difference' claim is explicitly post hoc at week 28 against a 17-patient comparator, and the 46% week-12 UAS7=0 sits at or below the 51% barzolvolimab published in a 208-patient Phase 2 that is already in Phase 3.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This name's eight comparable falls in 3 years split 4 up / 4 down with a median next close of -0.42% and a median absolute move of 6.45%, so a document-reading finding on this stock has historically been worth about a point, not a leg. The one comparable fall that kept going hardest, 2026-04-21 (-21.18% then -13.43%), was also a company-disclosure day.

findings.finding: The positive Phase 2 readout is itself a trigger under the Ascendant licence and purchase agreements - up to $205.0m of development and regulatory milestones payable 'including upon receipt of threshold data from a specified Phase 2 clinical trial', plus a Top-Up Obligation to issue Ascendant shares or pre-funded warrants taking it to no less than 7.5% of outstanding stock with a $15.0m value floor and explicitly no cap - and that obligation is disclosed only in a 10-Q footnote, not in the release that moved the stock.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The last time this company's Ascendant obligations were marked, the accounting itself was punitive: a $90.0m loss on issuance of liability-classified warrants in Q2 2026 because the stock rose between pricing and closing, and $35.1m of Q2 R&D expense from the licence of which $20.1m was the non-cash fair value of Ascendant pre-funded warrants and the related top-up obligations. The 2026-04-21 (-21.18%) and 2026-04-28 (-30.54%) falls sit in the same window as the Ascendant deal and the 1-for-30 reverse split.

findings.finding: An equity financing can be done inside the window with no board process and no marketing period: a $300m Form S-3 (File 333-294366) declared effective 2026-03-31 and an October 2021 Jefferies open-market sale agreement with about $36.8m of its $80m unused, against 7.26m shares outstanding, roughly $67m of pro-forma cash and a company that has just told the market it is 'working toward the rapid initiation of a Phase 2b/3 study in CSU' plus a Phase 2 in food allergy.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2025-12-19 fall (-21.64%, then -5.22% the next close) is this stock's own at-the-market day: the baseline's full-text probe puts an 'at-the-market' hit in an 8-K exhibit filed 2025-12-19 and a 424B5 on 2025-12-18. That is the one comparable fall where supply was the identified line, and it continued down the next session.

outside_window.finding: Full Phase 2 dataset including PK and IgE analyses from the 36-week study to be presented 'at an upcoming scientific meeting' - the single biggest swing factor for this name and the company gave it no date, so it cannot be scored here.

FDA review of 'the sufficiency of the data from the Phase 2 clinical trial of CUE-221 in CSU' gates both the planned Phase 2b/3 in CSU and the Phase 2 in food allergy; a China-only trial run by a related party is exactly the bridging question a US registrational path turns on. No date given.

Near-term Ascendant cash milestones outside the big $205m development/regulatory tranche: $5.0m on completion of manufacturing technology transfer and $6.5m on completion of data and know-how transfer. Both are undated and both are cash out of a ~$67m box.

Next FINRA short-interest dissemination, for the 2026-09-15 settlement, publishes about eight business days after settlement - around 2026-09-24. It is the first observation of any position built into the run-up, and it lands after this window closes.

Three CUE-100 series trials remain open with primary completion dates in 2027 and 2031 (NCT06917885, NCT04852328, NCT07172256); none of them can read out inside this window and none of them is the asset that moved the stock.
